what: Warning-level rules, a calibrated stacker and lead-window scoring applied to STORED forecasts (nothing trained). Written by code/warning_policy.py on 2026-10-30.
status: PRELIMINARY DIAGNOSTIC: not a reviewed experiment; every choice on validation years only, test years scored once per rule; no seed ranges, no intervals.

rules.csi: best pooled onset CSI on validation (the project's rule in scripts 16 and 18)
rules.far_cap: max pooled onset POD on validation subject to onset FAR <= 0.3 (the false share the GO rule allows)
rules.persistence: all-day false alarms on validation <= persistence's false alarms, then max onset hits, then max all-day hits, then fewer false alarms (Flood_Cloud_Model run.py choose())
rules.calibrated_stack: logistic regression on [log forecast/Q95 (seed mean), log today's flow/Q95, seed spread, seed max], fitted on the first half of validation, probability cut chosen on the second half by the far_cap rule, test scored once

far_cap.note: no trigger of the grid keeps the onset false share at or below the cap on validation; the trigger with the lowest false share is given
